files.summary: distinguish finite graph limits from whole-request validation and impact costs
edits:
There is no general resumable analysis executor in this release.

The finite graph bounds do not cap all preparation work: owning native validation runs before graph extraction, status-policy impact enumerates world entities and their effect instances, and cold definition fingerprinting processes whole policy/definition catalogues. These are synchronous server computations; short prompts and `ready_for_review` do not establish mature-world latency or memory bounds. [CTX02](limits/inventions.md#ctx02--preparation-and-disclosure-work) distinguishes the bounded graph from that remaining whole-request qualification under WW11. Preserve complete required checks and exact affected-episode identity when reducing this work, rather than truncating relevant effects to fit the graph limit.
